attribution: Substantive site and content updates. Routine dependency bumps are omitted.

entries.title: Content graph, browse hub, RSS, corrections, print polish
items: Typed `ContentGraph` on era hubs, pilot season blurbs (`graph` / `graphPlayerLabels`), and flagship longread; `ContentGraphRelated` UI.
`/browse` index, `/feed.xml` RSS (changelog + stories), site-wide RSS alternate, footer + about-data correction mailto (`NEXT_PUBLIC_CORRECTIONS_EMAIL`).
Era Open Graph/Twitter cards; longread `lastReviewed` + Article `dateModified`; print stylesheet and longread measure tweak.
Season blurbs merge **inferred** `ContentGraph` from era highlight seasons for every franchise year; `/seasons` faceted filters (playoffs + per-era highlights).
**STORY-004:** related reading from longread `contentGraph` on player/coach profiles; **all** era spotlight hubs per player via `getAllEraHubsForPlayer`.
`/players/leaders` tenure table (roster-season counts), home **This week in Wolves history** (`occursOn` anchors on timeline JSON), `/explore/2003-04-offseason` static stepper (**STORY-008**).
Longread **read mode** toggle; `mergeContentGraphs`; sitemap + leaders marked `force-dynamic` to avoid cold roster index build timeouts.

**DISC-002 v2 + DISC-009:** search memes, longread/era themes, season blurbs; `/browse?theme=` facet chips; **PROF-005:** leaders add best MIN PPG + playoff-era overlap via `getCachedWolvesLeadersAugmented`.

**HIST-003/004 UX:** season pages show an honest empty-state when curated JSON is missing; **STORY-008:** `/explore/2017-18-playoff-return`; **STORY-007 + HIST-006:** about-data policy + cache table + footer anchor; **PERF-001:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
**DISC-009 (themes):** `/seasons?theme=…` stacked with playoffs/era; `ContentGraphRelated` theme chips link to season index; `/browse` guided paths from `guided-paths.json`.
**HIST-006:** team-years `unstable_cache` bundle stores `fetchedAtIso`; footer shows last refresh when available.
**PROF-005:** leaders add **best MIN RPG** (cache key v2); player profiles show playoff-era overlap vs franchise feed.
**Content + HIST-003/004:** 2007–08 draft rows + transaction note; season graphs for 1995–96, 2007–08, 2015–16; `/explore/2007-garnett-trade`.
**DISC-002:** `siteSearch` returns **Theme** hits linking to `/seasons?theme=…`; **cursor.md §6.1** documents parallel agent ownership and merge order.

entries.title: Depth pass: stories, eras, drafts, transactions, search
items: Added flagship longread route with Article JSON-LD and `/stories` index.
Expanded era hubs (expansion, Garnett, post-KG, Butler, Finch-modern) with cross-links to essays.
Season pages can show curated draft picks and transaction notes when JSON exists for that year.
Player profiles: Wolves highlight bullets (computed or JSON override), related reading, resilient headshots.
New `/figures` capsules, `/changelog`, `/search`, and data freshness note in the shell.
